items.title: OpenAI's Busy Week: Math Breakthrough and Image Tools
points: OpenAI agents solved a mathematical problem unsolved for 90 years, demonstrating advanced reasoning capabilities in specialized domains.
ChatGPT Images 2.5 introduced @Sketch feature: type doodle descriptions and the AI converts them into pictures.
Company paused new ChatGPT Pro subscriptions, indicating capacity constraints from high demand.

items.title: Google Gemini Desktop App
points: Google released Gemini as a Windows desktop app with keyboard shortcuts for chat, image creation, and video generation integrated into workflow.

items.title: Apple's AI-Enhanced iPhone Lineup
points: iPhone Duo foldable joins iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max with Siri AI that understands personal context across apps.
Camera automatically detects when everyone in frame is posing before capturing the shot.
Photo editing tools use AI to enhance images intelligently based on scene understanding.

items.title: Shifting Prompt Strategies and Quality Updates
points: OpenAI released guidance on removing outdated instructions from old prompts, which hurt model performance on newer versions.
Quality update addressed issues on OpenAI's side affecting prompt reliability.
Refreshing prompts for current models yields better results than reusing legacy instructions.

items.title: AI Agents Get Their Own Hardware Home
points: Lapis One is a pocket computer designed specifically for AI agents (autonomous software that can perform multi-step tasks on its own) to run continuously between sessions.
Send jobs from phone, check progress via chat, and unplug without stopping work—built-in battery maintains active sessions.
Device plugs into another computer; agent can see screen, type, and move mouse without requiring software on host machine.

items.title: AI Animal Communication Ethics
points: AI animal communication raises new ethical questions about privacy, protection, and respecting animal preferences if AI can translate their calls.

headlines: OpenAI's agents solved a 90-year unsolved mathematics problem and launched ChatGPT Images 2.5 with sketch-to-image conversion, while pausing new Pro subscriptions due to demand.
Google released Gemini as a Windows desktop app with keyboard shortcuts for chat, image creation, and video generation integrated into your workflow.
Apple announced iPhone Duo (foldable) alongside iPhone 18 Pro models, featuring upgraded Siri AI with personal context awareness and smarter photo editing including automatic pose detection.
Lapis One pocket computer lets AI agents run continuously on their own hardware, executing tasks via chat while maintaining sessions across unplugged transitions with built-in battery.
AI animal communication raises new ethical questions about privacy, protection, and respecting animal preferences if AI can translate their calls.
